Build original-iPhone helper

Use macOS Xcode clang and the pinned cctools linker described in
../iphone-dataprotection/BUILD.txt. Supply a separately obtained iPhoneOS3.1.3
SDK; do not use the iPhone 3G's 4.0-minimum payload binaries on this RAM disk.

python3 third_party/iphone2g-helper/build.py --sdk /path/to/iPhoneOS3.1.3.sdk --linker /path/to/arm-apple-darwin10-ld --output /path/to/output

The build uses ARMv6/ARM1176JZF-S, minimum iOS 3.1, SDK 3.1.3, and the legacy
LC_UNIXTHREAD entry point. Ad-hoc signing includes primary SHA-1 and alternate
SHA-256 CodeDirectories. Linker warnings about duplicate minimum versions and
the current compiler-runtime archive's lack of ARMv6 are expected. Do not
ignore unresolved imports or alter the Mach-O header to claim compatibility.

Build twice and compare bytes. Validate every import against the actual
decrypted iPhone1,1 3.1.3/7E18 restore RAM disk (018-6494-014.dmg), not just the
SDK stubs. VALIDATION.json records these checks and exact input/output hashes.
Keep the payload ZIP, JSON metadata, source ZIP and validation record together.
The build writes iphone2g-helper.zip, iphone2g-helper.json and iphone2g-source.zip
to --output. After verification, copy those three files into ios_timeout/data
and copy NOTICE.txt there as iphone2g-NOTICE.txt. Regenerate the source ZIP after
updating VALIDATION.json so every app includes the exact build/validation source.
No Apple SDK, firmware, proprietary library or device data belongs in either
source or payload archives.
